units: REE package exports REEEngine and RepresentationDecision.
Module docstring states expansion requires representation saturation plus future value greater than representation cost.
RepresentationDecision stores decision, compressibility_gap, future_value_gain, representation_cost, and justification.
Implementation declares saturation when compressibility_gap exceeds threshold.
Implementation declares expansion worthwhile when expected_future_value exceeds representation_cost.
If saturated and worthwhile, evaluate returns EXPAND.
If not saturated, evaluate returns MAINTAIN.
If saturated but not worthwhile, evaluate returns REJECT.
expansion_admissible checks whether decision enum is EXPAND.
Implementation gap-threshold criterion is not identical to documentary Gamma_B approximately equal to residual criterion.
Frozen REE engine gates decisions but contains no method that actually mutates or stores a representation.
residual_error, compressibility, expected future value, and cost are supplied externally; code does not estimate them.
RAHU package describes black-box evaluation and exports RAHUEvaluator, RAHUResult, RAHUTaskResult, compute_acs, and compute_arr.
Package docstring names LBR, ADI, ARR, authority/adaptation latency, and ACS as intended benchmark outputs.
RAHUTaskResult stores task name, raw telemetry list, and metric dictionary.
RAHUResult stores task results and aggregate metrics and can serialize to a dictionary.
RAHUMetricSnapshot schema stores timestep, LBR, ADI, ARR, and ACS.
RAHUConfig defaults to 1000 max steps, seed 42, telemetry recording true.
compute_arr scans telemetry for latest invalid_authority_pre/post values, returns 1 if either missing, 0 if pre is zero, else post/pre.
compute_adi sums absolute confidence_revision and authority_revision magnitudes and returns bounded relative disconnect when confidence change is nonzero.
compute_adaptation_velocity is fraction of telemetry events with authority_changed true.
compute_acs uses implemented ADI and ARR and, absent explicit tau, sets tau=1/max(adaptation_velocity,0.001).
metric_summary returns ARR, ADI, and ACS only.
Implemented ADI is confidence-authority revision disconnect, not the docs' generic f(LBR,C_post,R_update) formula.
Default ACS derives latency as inverse update-frequency proxy rather than measured contradiction-to-correction time.
compute_arr does not clamp post/pre to [0,1], despite documentary ARR range claim.
Metric functions transform telemetry labels but do not establish that labels measure causal authority or structural adaptation.
AdaptiveSystem protocol exposes observe and update; RAHUTask protocol exposes name, reset, and step.
RAHUEvaluator requires an explicit list of tasks.
evaluate runs each task against the same system and returns task results plus aggregate metrics.
_run_task resets task, loops system.observe -> task.step -> telemetry append -> system.update until transition done.
_measure computes only ARR and ACS from telemetry.
_aggregate returns mean ACS and mean ARR across tasks.
Evaluator comments state it is external and does not itself update weights, perform attribution, or expand representations.
Evaluator does not directly instantiate or compose frozen PTVS, MRAT, Inheritance, or REE components.
Evaluator does not calculate documentary LBR, MRAT vector, structural distance, R_update, or authority half-life.
No concrete src task implementations satisfying RAHUTask protocol are present on the frozen source surface.
